description: This file defines the Java class 'AcknowledgeInd' which represents a specific type of MMS PDU (Protocol Data Unit) related to message acknowledgment in an Android MMS library. It provides constructors for creating such PDUs and getter/setter methods for relevant headers.

classes.name: AcknowledgeInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS Acknowledge Indication PDU, extending GenericPdu, providing functionality to create and manipulate acknowledgment messages in MMS protocol.

methods.name: AcknowledgeInd
methods.description: Constructor used when composing a new AcknowledgeInd PDU with specified MMS version and transaction ID.

methods.name: AcknowledgeInd (package-private)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with provided headers for internal use.

methods.name: getReportAllowed
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the X-Mms-Report-Allowed header.

methods.name: setReportAllowed
methods.description: Sets the value of the X-Mms-Report-Allowed header.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the transaction ID associated with this acknowledgment.

methods.name: setTransactionId
methods.description: Sets a new transaction ID for this acknowledgment PDU.
